liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Oteil's bass solo begins around 13:18, with the heaviest low-end playing arriving near 15:17; Considered one of the best Eyes versions this listener has seen [10][14]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): The opening song was partly missed by this latecomer [11]
- Half-Step was played in a very mellow style [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **DC2016-06-28i 01 Hell in A Bucket**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **DC2016-06-28i 02 Cold Rain and Snow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **DC2016-06-28i 03 Queen Jane**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **DC2016-06-28i 04 Big River**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **DC2016-06-28i 05 Row Jimmy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **DC2016-06-28i 06 Miss Half Step**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **DC2016-06-28i 07 Cumberland Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **DC2016-06-28ii 08 Estimated**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]

## The recordings

- **GD2016-06-28.AKG** (recommended): source not stated; 17 songs; 198 min; rated 4.9/5 by 10 [1]
- **DeadCompany2016-06-28**: source not stated; 17 songs; 187 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Listener was present and finds this recording slightly clearer than the one posted for 6/29 [12]

## Around the show

- Listener sat beside a newcomer to the Dead's music and an experienced fan, both astonished by Mayer's playing [6]
- Listener from Vermont recalls Hartford as a nearby venue, and once camping on the State House lawn for three nights [7]
- Listener arrived late and missed part of the opening Hell in a Bucket [11]
- Taped dead center at the rear of the GA pit, at head height in set one and about 7.5 feet in set two [2]
- Only a radio broadcast of the Citi Field shows, on Soundcloud, had been found by this listener [5]
- Mayer was stretching his jams further and creating memorable moments; Bobby seemed energized and the rhythm section solid [6]
- Noted no audience recordings seem to exist from the Citi Field shows, wondering whether tapers were barred [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **GD2016-06-28.AKG**: taped by Mark Van Blunk; transferred by Mark Van Blunk; source: 4 mic mix- 2 AKG c414 mics (Card) & 2 AKG c451ck1 mics>Tascam DR-70D (as preamp)>Sony M10 @24bit/48kHz [1]. Also: Reviewer added an etree source link and made their own checksum and text file for the source info; Transferred via Sound Forge Studio 9 to 16-bit/44.1kHz, then ripped to FLAC level 8 by MVB [1][3]
- **DeadCompany2016-06-28**: taped by Jay; transferred by Jay; source: Source: Schoeps MK4's>Schoeps CMR's>Naiant PFA>Edirol R-44 OCM [2]
